text: Name a model released by OpenAI
note: Any model or named AI system from OpenAI: GPT/o-series, API models, image/audio/video, RL agents, research models. Not libraries, envs, benchmarks or PPO

aka: Learning to Generate Reviews and Discovering Sentiment
answers.q: A byte-level mLSTM trained only to predict the next character of 82M Amazon reviews grew a single neuron for sentiment.
OpenAI's first model served on Cerebras wafer-scale chips, built for real-time coding at 1,000+ tokens a second.
A gated life-sciences reasoning model named after Rosalind Franklin, whose X-ray work revealed DNA's helix.
OpenAI's 2023 AI-writing detector caught just 26% of AI text. Quietly retired six months later for low accuracy.

aka: Text and Code Embeddings by Contrastive Pre-Training
Generative Language Modeling for Automated Theorem Proving
answers.q: A transformer theorem prover whose shorter Metamath proofs were accepted into the main set.mm library.
Sol, Terra and Luna: the sun is the flagship, the earth the mid-tier, and the moon the cheap one.

aka: Guided Language to Image Diffusion for Generation and Editing
Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
answers.q: Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021. The paper title did all the talking: Diffusion Models Beat GANs.

aka: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
answers.q: A Shadow Hand trained only in simulation that solved a Rubik's Cube, even with a plush giraffe poking at it.

aka: Emergent Tool Use From Multi-Agent Autocurricula
answers.q: Seekers taught themselves to 'box surf' over walls, a physics-engine exploit nobody designed in.
Watched 70,000 hours of Minecraft YouTube, then crafted diamond tools: about 24,000 actions for a human.

aka: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
answers.q: Radford et al., 2018: a 117M-parameter transformer decoder pretrained on books, then fine-tuned per task.
The GPT-3 line tuned with instructions and RLHF; ChatGPT launched on it in November 2022.

aka: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
answers.q: RLHF goes mainstream: labelers preferred the 1.3B InstructGPT over the 175B GPT-3.
Before launch it ran in stealth on OpenRouter as 'Quasar Alpha'. Coders loved it; the name gave nothing away.
Codename Orion. Huge and pricey, and pulled from the API less than five months after launch.
Astra arrived Sept 3, 2026. With Sol, Terra and Luna tiers around it, the model picker is now a planetarium.
Codename Strawberry. Thinks before it answers, and bills you for the thinking you never see.
There was no o2: the name belonged to a British phone network.
OpenAI's open-weight models, August 2025: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, under Apache 2.0.

aka: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
answers.q: GPT fine-tuned on GitHub: the original Copilot's brain, and the paper that introduced HumanEval.

aka: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
answers.q: OpenAI, 2022: turns the text into a CLIP image embedding, then decodes that with diffusion (unCLIP).
OpenAI, 2023: trained on recaptioned images so it follows prompts closely. Built into ChatGPT.
4o image generation set off the March 2025 Studio Ghibli craze; developers got it as gpt-image-1.
Video with synced sound plus a TikTok-style app, Sept 2025. Both the app and the API were gone within a year.
Raw-audio songs with vocals, 2020. Rendering one minute took about nine hours.
Beat Dota 2 world champions OG in April 2019, after roughly 45,000 years of self-play.
Dec 2022: one model replaced five, at 1,536 dims. The default vector of every early RAG tutorial.

aka: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
answers.q: 400M web image–caption pairs. Matched ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without seeing one of its 1.28M labels.

aka: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
answers.q: 680,000 hours of weakly labeled web audio. The open-source ASR everyone reaches for first.

aka: Video generation models as world simulators
answers.q: Feb 2024: a minute of video, opening on a stylish walk down a neon Tokyo street. Everyone remembers the reveal.
March 2023. It accepted images, and its technical report withheld the model's size and architecture.
Technically a product, not a model. We'll allow it.
2020, 175B parameters. Showed that a big enough model learns a task from a few examples in the prompt.

aka: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
answers.q: 'Too dangerous to release' in Feb 2019. The full 1.5B weights came out nine months later.
The o is for omni. It was tested anonymously on Chatbot Arena as 'im-also-a-good-gpt2-chatbot'.
August 2025: one system that routes each request between a fast model and a deeper reasoning model.
WALL·E meets Dalí. Its 2021 avocado armchairs launched a thousand prompts.
